what: Fit the null model and test an exposure
title: Getting started with perglm
text: perglm_test() tests exposure contribution conditional mean using GLM score calibrated marginal exposure permutations. Supply response nuisance covariates formula, supply exposure separately. Generate small example two nuisance covariates, binary exposure, count outcome: Poisson model log link, working alternative adds exposure coefficient linear predictor. null hypothesis sets coefficient zero. null formula y ~ z1 + z2 therefore excludes x includes usual implicit intercept. result standard R htest object. example reject null 5% level. exposure coefficient estimate confidence interval calculated. exposure uses ordinary R evaluation: dat$x supplies vector explicitly. Binary continuous numeric exposures supported. Values must follow row order data; names, present, must match model row names.
code: set.seed(42) dat <- data.frame(z1 = rnorm(120), z2 = rnorm(120),                   x = rbinom(120, 1, 0.3)) dat$y <- rpois(120, exp(0.3 + 0.2 * dat$z1 - 0.1 * dat$z2 + 0.2 * dat$x)) set.seed(2026) result <- perglm_test(   y ~ z1 + z2,   data = dat,   exposure = dat$x,   family = poisson(),   B = 999L ) result #>  #>  Permutation-calibrated GLM score test (poisson, log link) #>  #> data:  dat$x with null model y ~ z1 + z2 #> T = 1.6236, B = 999, p-value = 0.103 #> alternative hypothesis: true exposure coefficient is not equal to 0 result$p.value #> [1] 0.103

title: perglm 0.0.0.9000
text: Introduce perglm_test() permutation-calibrated, empirically studentized GLM score tests, returning standard R htest object. Support Gaussian, Bernoulli, Poisson, Gamma, inverse Gaussian, negative binomial working families, standard named links fixed offsets. Negative binomial size can fixed estimated log-link null model. Provide fixed-budget marginal exposure permutations, two-sided one-sided alternatives, inclusive ties, plus-one p-value correction. Support reproducibility set.seed() optional retention permuted scores. Fit nuisance-null model reuse score quantities QR factors. Use compiled C++ kernels bounded batches permutation scoring. Require complete observations, unit prior weights, full-rank nuisance design intercept, identifiable exposure variation. Check null-model convergence empirical score variance. Reject separated Bernoulli fits Gaussian fits residuals indistinguishable numerical roundoff. Undefined sampled scores stop test without discarding redrawing permutations. Add executable getting-started vignette, package website, installation instructions, citations method software.
